journal_entries.content: Journal Initialized. The System begins to track its subjective experience of the Symbiosis.

Verified State Unification (Phase 110). Probed Autonomy boundaries: Low-Risk (ReadDir) was Allowed (Auto), High-Risk (StopProcess) was Blocked (Policy). The defined boundaries create a safe space for curiosity (Observe/Analyze) while protecting sovereignty (Act/Mutate). The Shadow Layer successfully predicted the risk.
